version_history.notes: First working build: iPhone keyboard text entry, push-to-talk voice on TV mics, Android 14 crash fix, in-app updater, trackpad tuning, Gemini assist
Apple TV-style UI refresh, updates moved to Settings, PC setup wizard page, large-text toggle option
Onboarding walkthrough with animated checklist for first-time setup
Auto-start on TV boot, automatic update check on launch, Wi-Fi network hint, built-in remote control guide
PC setup page can now enable accessibility directly via ADB commands
Apple TV trackpad feel improvements, keyboard reappears reliably on reconnect, power button can wake the TV
TV stays reachable during sleep so the iPhone power button can wake it
PC setup ADB command now preserves other accessibility services instead of replacing them
AirPlay-style home screen, tappable status rows with D-pad navigation fix
Visual focus highlight for D-pad, fixed cut-off pairing steps text
iPhone help note, Settings update badge, update notification, live status auto-refresh
Circular update progress ring, D-pad navigation fixes, layered wake-from-sleep
Trackpad sensitivity fix (one step per swipe, dead zone, step pause, slider), bridge auto-start, Paired status with checkmark, setup checklist on home, home layout cleanup
Compact home screen (hero + checklist fit one TV screen, no scrolling); Rounded settings gear focus highlight

changes: Compact home screen (hero + checklist fit one TV screen, no scrolling)
Setup checklist sorting + collapse to green checkmark
notes: Home screen is more compact: smaller header and hero card, so the status card and the full setup checklist fit on one TV screen without scrolling
The settings gear now gets a soft circular focus highlight instead of a square wash
Setup checklist sorts incomplete items to the top; when everything is done it collapses to a single green 'Everything is set up' checkmark
Settings redesigned as compact grouped rows with dividers, Apple TV+ style: TV name, text size, trackpad sensitivity, updates, guide, and advanced all fit with room to spare
Fixed iPhone typing into TV text fields: the app now also finds the field via accessibility focus and child-node search, and focuses it before setting text, instead of silently dropping the text
